articleTitle: Controlling and Monitoring of Power Theft using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The demand for electricity increases at a rapid pace as a country modernizes and its economy grows. The demand-supply gap in power in India has been increasing steadily in recent years. Smart grid is a recent development that improves the quality of power delivery to consumers by allowing two-way communication and the distribution of smart devices. Though reliable, it does have defects like Power Quality issues such as harmonics, voltage and frequency fluctuations, Storage, Protection issues and Islanding. Power theft is one of the most serious problems. Stealing of electrical power is referred to as electricity theft. This paper proposes an Internet of Things (IoT) based Power theft monitoring & control system which can monitor the real time current through all the constituent network as well as the source. So that in case of any power theft the power cut can occur automatically or manually based upon this real time data.

articleTitle: Comparative Study Between Different Controllers Of DVR For Power Quality Improvement
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Protection of critical loads from power quality issues is inadequate due to its negative impact on modem domestic and industrial equipment. The mitigation of power quality problems may be distributed by the employment of Custom power devices (CPD) at grid. "Dynamic voltage restorer" (DVR) is employed for the protection of vital loads against voltage connected power quality issue. DVR can detect and compensate for long-term drops in the applied AC voltage, thereby isolating the entire group from these power supply reliability issues. This paper is focused on comparative study between two different control schemes for DVR such as proportional integral controller (PI) and Artificial neural network (ANN). Both the control schemes are simulated using MATLAB/ SIMULINK and the results depict the comparison of these two control schemes.

articleTitle: Smart Bus and Bus Stop Management System using IoT Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: In India, many forms of public transportation are convenient for the users, amidst them buses play a key role. An average person in a city roughly spends thirty minutes for bus arrival every single day that merely adds up eight hours a week. Energy consumption by buses has dramatically increased and so the dependency on petroleum with raising pollution. In addition, lack of proper bus transportation data like navigation, timetable, and seat availability in the bus. The practice of paper tickets causing environmental damage by deforestation and also poor services like seating, lighting, shelter in the bus station. Our proposed system aims to provide better bus management that is capable of bus tracking, route scheduling, E-ticketing via IoT, eventually making commuter’s journey peaceful, saving paper through digitalization.

articleTitle: Enhanced Data Encryption in IOT using ECC Cryptography and LSB Steganography
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Internet of Things is a dynamic field wherein transfer of data transpires every single instant. Although in recent times various hybrid mechanisms that combine both steganography and cryptography have been proposed to ensure security in data communication networks since a standalone method does not provide adequate security and reliability. In the case of cryptography, if a perpetrator is to guess the secret key, they can easily decrypt and access desired data. On the flip side, if changes are somehow visible in an image, the perpetrator may apply steganography techniques to recover the plaintext. Therefore, this paper presents a novel mechanism for efficient and safe data communication. The proposal uses both cryptographic and steganographic techniques to provide optimum level of security to the secret data. The cryptographic technique used is Elliptic Curve Cryptography and the steganography technique used is LSB.

articleTitle: Video Based Drowning Detection System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: At present, there are swimming pools in every part of the world. Most of the swimming pool accidents or incidents occur due to improper security. Therefore, Accidental deaths in swimming pools are actually increasing. So, Video based drowning detection system is designed in this article. The proposed system structure comprises raspberry pi (Single Board Computer) equipped with a USB camera for taking the live feed from the pool area. The system also covers the alerting phenomena using a buzzer so that necessary actions are taken intermittently without any delay. The working structure starts from the raspberry pi with image processing for video feed intake, deep learning for activity recognition and finally GPIO system for alerting and short message service.

articleTitle: Real Time Water Treatment Plant Monitoring System using IOT and Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Here paper points at designing programmed water treatment plant that measures quality of water utilizing various parameters like temperature, pH, turbidity and TDS. In order of achieving this several sensors that measure distinctive parameters like pH value, turbidity in water, level of the water within the tank, temperature and humidity of the surrounding atmosphere are interfaced with Arduino microcontroller unit. The received data from the Arduino will be sent to the cloud with the help of IOT Things speak app to monitor the quality of water. The machine learning algorithm is applied to the obtained sensor information to extend the precession.

articleTitle: Internet of Things-based Baby Monitoring System for Smart Cradle
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: In the current era, internet is an ecosystem within which IoT (Internet of Things) has continuously enhanced the physical and wireless connection of devices with less to no intervention of humans. According to a survey in 2019 there are 23.8 million (two-third) working women with babies; managing work along with babysitting is a hectic task. Thus, internet of things (IoT) based baby monitoring system for smart cradle is implemented to fulfil baby’s needs and provides intimation to parents. A smart baby cradle provides parents/guardian an automatic system which helps these parents monitor and comfort the baby through online streaming via camera. The cradle includes MP3 player for soothing music, temperature detector and bed wet sensor are embedded into ESP32 wroom (microcontroller) platform. Availability of high speed internet facilitates using IoT platform with ease, and any ambiguity caused to the infant will be reported to parents in the form of SMS via GSM. Prevention for child abuse is also taken care in our model.

articleTitle: Development of Head Motion Controlled Wheelchair
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Mobility assistance is vital for physically challenged people and elderly people. The objectives of this paper are to design a wheelchair that can be controlled by head motions. Quadriplegics who can't use their hands or legs but can move their heads could benefit from this system. The disabled individual may maneuver this wheelchair in any direction using head tilt motions. The construction of a head motion-controlled wheelchair has been made possible by the use of tilt sensors and diode logic. The prototype of the system is built, and its operation is found to be satisfactory. In comparison to traditional joystick-controlled wheelchairs, the proposed wheelchair is developed at a lesser cost. The head motion-controlled wheelchair is designed to assist quadriplegic patients & elderly people as they can operate it without any external assistance.

articleTitle: Smart Shopping Cart using IOT and robotic arm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Shopping has become a daily routine in urban areas. Customers buy distinctive things and place them in the trolley and proceed to the billing section. But what makes this activity worn out is the waiting queue line at the cash register. In this paper, "SMART SHOPPING CART USING IOT AND ROBOTIC ARM". Our main agenda is to eradicate the traditional billing methodology and reduce human efforts. Through IOT we can monitor gadgets and surroundings wirelessly, this initiates usage of tags electronically, when these tags approach in the span of the reader it reads the information stored in the RFID tag with the help of RFID technology. Unlike barcode scanners, RFID is the fundamental mechanism feature of our exploration. Wherein RFID tags are used for recognition of item, RFID reader which is pre-owned for scanning of goods and robotic arm to place products in the trolley this helps the disabled people who are unable to pick and scan of products and details are displayed on the LCD, and the customer can do the payment in their hand itself without waiting in the long queue. Our proposed prototype infers rapidly paying one's bill and gets rid of standing in a queue, customers can do the online payment which totally prevents burglary.

articleTitle: Smart Watering System using Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: This study tells an intelligent Smart Watering System (SWS) for smart water consumption in small and medium sized gardens, which is helped by an Android application. Gardens and fields of a medium scale. The system that has been proposed is based on a set of low-cost and inexpensive sensors obtain information on plants and their surroundings, such as moisture content of soil, intensity of light, humidity of air and Temperature in air.Data from sensors are gathered on a server, the suggested SWS uses a Block-chain and Fuzzy Logic technique to determine the watering schedule. In this scenario, Fuzzy Logic aids in making smart watering decisions, while Block-chain offers the necessary safety in an IoT-enabled system by accessing only trusted devices to allow and manage proposed watering schedules. In the proposed IoT base smart system, Block chain technology takes part an essential character in our approach by offering scalability, insularity, and dependability. Observing and engaging with plants with the help of the SWS Developed on Android (SWS) Application. The SWS triggers the actuators to perform watering activities such as switching water tunnels ON/OFF on a regular basis when the Fuzzy Logic-based system determine on an action based on the values of the input variables.

articleTitle: Performance Enhancement of Solar Panel Using Dual Axis Solar Tracker
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The design, development and assembly of microcontroller based Dual Axis Solar Tracker to enhance the performance of an immobile Solar Photo Voltaic (SPV) panel is presented in this paper. Four Light Dependent Resistors (LDRs) act as sensors to determine the intensity of sunbeams and communicate the same to Arduino UNO’s microcontroller. Depending on the command given by Arduino Uno’s microcontroller, the solar panel is being tilted perpendicular to the incident sun’s rays by using two servomotors. Thus, the developed prototype ensures that the efficiency of photovoltaic panel is increased in comparison to static solar photovoltaic panel.

articleTitle: Smart Mirror Using Rasberry Pi for Human Monitoring and Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: As this world is expecting a new technology, people are busy with time instead of freely passing. As we are with busy world we need to make our life advance and tension free with the use of improvement in technology. In this advancement of mirror project we are using interactive gesture. It will be mainly of two modes of operation, first is normal mode and another one is advanced mode or triggered mode. In normal mode it will act as a fine mirror and in advanced mode it accepts different form of inputs from user and gives output on display. The three main ways in which input can we given are voice, touch and through mobile apps. It displays daily routine things like date, day, temperature, rain and about our schedule for the day. It is mainly built to monitor and to detect intrusion of humans. We can also add many packages to it and we can make it more advance. It is not only used for above mentioned things rather it is used for security purposes. This system is formed with hardware mainly of Raspberry pi3B+, screen, mobile app, camera and PIR sensors and programmed with python Yolo machine learning technology with open CV is also used.

articleTitle: Contactless Authentication Device using Palm Vein and Palm Print Fusion Biometric Technology for Post Covid World
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: This paper proposes a secure, contactless authentication and biometric identification system incorporating palm vein and palm print image fusion. It acts as a security device without the need to physically touch it. In a world still recuperating from the aftermath of the COVID-19 pandemic, our no-contact device would find particular use in office spaces, educational institutes, etc. The system comprises near-infrared (NIR), light-emitting diode (LED) arrays, a low-cost complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) visual sensor, a ‘Raspberry Pi SBC’, and other components. In real-time, the palm vein and palm-print images are acquired at the same time with real-time Image Quality Assessment and Correction (IQAC). Vein and palm print features of interest are then made prominent using certain preprocessing algorithms. To reduce image storage requirements, we implement a wavelet-based fusion strategy on the images. Finally, using a deep scattering convolutional network, features are extracted. Although at present, a system uses state vector machines for training and recognition, this article advances the state-of-the-art method by introducing reduced vector machines to biometric authentication applications. Characteristics of some other biometric identification systems are also discussed to highlight features. The operational requirements of our proposed prototype are significantly lesser than fusion strategies employed by earlier technologies. It also proves to be more economical when implemented on a large scale, thus increasing the commercial viability of our system.

articleTitle: Intelligent Helmet for Miners
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Safety is a very important concern for every human being, a lite carelessness will lead to unexpected hazards and some of them may lead to loss of life. One of the most unsafe industry to work is mining industries, and the life of miners are always at a risk. There are lot of dangerous accidents which cause more death of miners are reported from mines located in different countries. The major reason for those hazards are, the concentration of the gases like methane gas and CNG (compressed natural gas) and other harmful gases which expose from underneath of earth while excavation, next main reason is the removal of helmet by miners and it increases chances of head injuries. The monitoring of miners health and the unusual events happens on the mine by supervisor will improve the safety and very useful for avoiding big accidents. This project attempts to develop a sensor integrated intelligent helmet for miners which increases the safety parameters of mines. Sensors used in this helmet are the force sensor, gas sensor, temperature sensor and IR sensor (infra red) . All quantities of sensors measured by the Arduino microcontroller based development board interfaced to the sensors and communicated to the base station via wireless sensor network (WSN) created by NRF modules. The base station module consists of raspberry pi with monitor and an alert system. Real-time events like helmet removal by miner, different gases and temperature levels variations in working space, and collisions are displayed on the monitor placed in the control room (base station). The alert system activates for every unexpected events and the supervisor can monitor it from the graphical user interface (GUI) developed in raspberry pi.

articleTitle: Inter Vehicle Communication using Vehicular Ad-hoc Network (VANET)
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: In recent years there has been a drastic increase in the number of vehicles available, due to the high mass of vehicles on roads leads to an increase in traffic and causes accidents. The main objective here is Communication where each vehicle can exchange and communicate with other vehicles and with the Road side unit (RSU). The RSU transmits real time data of different road scenarios to the nearby vehicles and if an accident has occurred the vehicle transmits the data to other vehicles within the ad-hoc range and to the traffic control room via RSU, so as to receive immediate medical assistance. This up-coming technology is referred to as Vehicular Ad-hoc Network (VANET) which helps in achieving this communication.

articleTitle: Classification and Comparison of Covid-19 Patients
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Coronavirus is a common virus that shows symptoms of infections in nose, chest pain, sinuses, or throat. Most Sars - coronaviruses are harmless. After the 2019 outbreak in the penultimate month in China, the World Health Organization (WHO) identified SARS-CoV-2 as the latest coronavirus spreading all over the world. The disease is spreading rapidly around the world and affecting millions of people physically and mentally as well. In this paper a comparison of 8 pre-trained Machine Learning models predominately different versions of ResNet is done and compared. The used models for comparisons are InceptionV3, EfficientNet, VGG16, ResNet50, ResNet50v2, ResNetlOl, ResNetl01v2, ResNetl52. Finally, it will be deduced which model is best suited for the given dataset of Covid-19.

articleTitle: Surveillance Through Semi-Autonomous Bot
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: This paper consists of the design and implementation of the semi-autonomous surveillance bot. The idea presented in the paper is to monitor a surrounding or unknown area. This paper carries the different phases of realization such as the motion of the robot, obstacle avoidance, and video capturing and streaming. After the video has been captured the recorded clip is streamed to a remote server which assesses the surrounding. For the implementation of the idea, different tools were required for the execution of the precursor. For building the model, the hardware required was Raspberry Pi, infrared sensors, L293D motor driver. Raspberry Pi consisting of a Raspbian operating system running on python language for video capturing and obstacle sensing was used.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Vision For Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The object detection concept is widely used for automation or tracking purpose; hence, it is used in self-driving cars. There are many applications other than automation that use object detection but are not explored in depth till date. This research involves one such application that uses object detection to help the visually impaired to identify the objects ahead of them for safe navigation. A few attempts have been previously made to implement such a device, but it was only confined to small objects. The results show that the proposed system implements both object detection and an ultrasonic sensor and GPS module to monitor location. SSD- Mobile Net is used to implement the object detection to obtain greater accuracy.

articleTitle: Gray Scale Image Colorization for Human Faces
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Image colorization is an eclectic topic of research. Former approaches to the gray scale image colorization problem rely on manual methods with human intervention that produced some de-saturated results that are not likely to be true colorizations. To fully automate the process of colorization, enormous amount of computation power and datasets are required which is daunting. This paper proposes an approach to fully automate the task using an autoencoder model. This can be useful in colorizing old black and white pictures and movie snapshots. We used Convolution Neural Network (CNN) for colorization because of its ability to deal with image datasets. The experimental results demonstrated that this method outperforms the state of art technique.

articleTitle: Smart Door Lock System For The Elderly And Disabled
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Being surrounded by ever-growing smart applications, technology is revolutionizing the world. Smart devices can be pivotal in possession of elderly and disabled people with adequate access. The proposed model consists of a smart lock system which can be administered with remote access through an app using our smartphones. The owner has access to the movement of the door. Upon ringing of the doorbell, a notification is sent to our phones, where we can use the access of live video coverage to identify the person at the door and decide whether to provide permittance to the person by opening the door lock using the app. Thus, this will resolve the problem of elderly and disabled people who are incapable of reaching out to the door. This paper also has other proposed systems such as fire detecting modules and other sensors. In case of an intruder trying to break in, the buzzer gets activated and alerts the owner. It also has a password based system with keypad to have access to the door from outside. Therefore this project is cost effective and easy to implement and uncomplicated to use makes the project very useful.

articleTitle: Automatic Irrigation System Using GSM Module
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Modern digitalized era of our 21st century needs automation in each and every sector. In India forming is called the vertebrae of the country because most part of India depend upon agriculture so automation in agriculture will surely help in lifting up lift the country’s economy and irrigation is the most basic requirement of the agriculture. The exercise of proper method of irrigation system is very reasonable and proficient this method will reduce the human interference with the irrigation and provide the proper water management. To achieving the automation in the fields with irrigation we require various hardware and software components such as GSM for wireless communication, sensors to check the status of the soil and Arduino etc. The arranged framework is working with programmed activity, which considers detected information alongside the climate conjecture boundaries like precipitation, air temperature, stickiness, and UV for the not-so-distant future. The total framework has been created and conveyed on a pilot scale, where the sensor hub information is remotely gathered over the cloud utilizing webservices and an online data perception and choice emotionally supportive network gives the continuous data bits of knowledge dependent on the investigation of sensors information and climate estimate information [1]-[2]. This paper targets fostering the GSM based mechanized water system framework which give satisfactory water needed by crop by checking the dampness of soil and environment condition to forestall the wastage of water asset. It will likewise enjoy numerous benefits for ranchers.

articleTitle: Brain-Computer Interface Based Home Automation System Using Eye Blink Detection for Paralyzed People
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The neural information from human brain is obtained and are interpreted to information processing system required to perform a specific function is the Brain-Computer Interface (BCI). Replacing the physical activity, conversation and surroundings control for incapacitated individuals is the final ambitious goal of a BCI. In order to manage an intelligent house application, the brain-computer interface system was connected with the computerized simulation system. It is a synthetic system that detour the body’s traditional economical passageways, that square measure the contractile organ production medium. It offers a substitute to ordinary communication and management. Distinct designs of neuronal communication derive distinct brain conditions. Waves described by distinct magnitudes and frequencies are guided by these designs. Multiple neurons are responsible for this neural interaction. Minuscule electrical discharge is created by every interaction between neurons. This paper deals with the brain neural signals. The message produced by brain was acquired by the brain detector. These messages are split up into data packets and this packet data will be conveyed to transmission channel. The wave measurement section can acquire the brain wave messages and using MATLAB GUI platform the data is converted into signal. Then the commands are going to be causing to the home segment to work the components like fan and light. This system is employed with a person brain assumption and voluntary blinking of eyes which controls the home appliance ON/OFF condition.

articleTitle: Smart Vehicle Accident Detection System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: We humans often travel from one place to another for various reasons. One of the important mode of transport is via road. Nowadays the cars are no longer a means of luxury but rather a ‘need’ for transportation. Day in and day out, even for shorter distances we tend to use our cars. Through the recent years, accidents are increased due the increase in the vehicles on road. Further the new generation of cars have emerged which are meant to reduce the accidents caused. However, despite the implementation of innovative ideas to reduce accidents in the modem cars. There are still chances of occurrence of accidents. It is of a greater importance to reduce the number of accidents cases and to protect human lives. One of the major reasons for the loss of lives is the delay of medical treatment of the injured person. Due to the ignorance of the people, help to the injured person is delayed thereby costing their lives. As the technology advances, the need for providing a more reliable system for helping the people increases. Thus we have designed a system using GSM, GPS and smart sensors to accurately send SMS to the nearby hospitals and to the family member of the injured person when accident takes place.

articleTitle: Indian Currency Detection Using Image Recognition Technique
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Today, Counterfeit notes are one of the biggest problems occurring in currency note transactions. This has become an acute problem to almost all the countries today. In developing countries like India, it is becoming a serious issue. Due to advancement in color printing, duplication and scanning, this problem has become more serious. Our approach follows a simple pattern matching algorithm to detect counterfeit notes. Initially the required features will be extracted and stored in a MATLAB file. Later the input is processed using the algorithms to find fake notes and also the denomination of the provided input notes.

articleTitle: Environmentally Friendly Power: Potential, Status, and Challenges in Jharkhand
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: India has a populace of about 1.35 billion plus individuals and is a developing finance. In like manner, high interest on energy is required. As of now the primary source of power is coal which is non-sustainable for the environment. Thus, there is a significance to track down an elective source of potential. By implementing this we tend to minimize conventional energy resource and increase renewable energy resources that enjoys few benefits. Ministry of New and Renewable Energy Resources (MNRE) has dispatched numerous plans for the support of RERs as well as for the commercial area to utilize sustainable power. In Eastern part of India the province of Jharkhand holds fourth spot in generating electricity from RERs. This paper examines environmentally friendly power utilized for the betterment of a group of people yet to come from Jharkhand state

articleTitle: Automated temperature monitoring and cooling system using Thermoelectric generators and W1209 temperature actuators
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: this paper proposes another technology for forced cooling of the heat sink installed on the CPU. Due to overheating of electronic equipment, its efficiency is decreasing and it has many effects on the biosphere. The purpose of this article is to explore techniques to reduce the heat generated by electronic devices. This article presents the limitations of existing methods and suggests ways to improve the performance of electronic devices. Use commercially available computational fluid dynamics software [3] to perform numerical analysis on radiator efficiency, the influence of turbulence mode, the influence of radiation heat transfer [3], and different radiator geometries. For all electronic cards and packaging, conjugate heat transfer [3] is simulated. Use a network independent model with good convergence and good planning.

articleTitle: Exploiting Mobile-to-Mobile wireless energy sharing for charging relief
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: In day-to-day life, increasing software potentialities, growing technology and complex applications running behind smartphones have increased the aspect of life for the person. However, the battery packs of smartphones have stayed finite due to slower upgrade in battery technology. To charge phone users must find a charging port and plug the Smartphone into the port through a snake-look-alike cable. So, this procedure can be irritating or sometimes infeasible and also charge a phone if there are no other means of charging like power bank, charging through a port, but we have other’s smartphone with a full charge of battery our project plays an important role and provides a greater means of opportunity for two users worldwide. In this paper, we investigate the potential of mobile-to-mobile energy sharing between gadgets to reduce the limitations effectively by adopting wireless Power transfer between two gadgets through inductive coupling is an effective method which relieved many problems.

articleTitle: Arduino Based System to Prevent Vehicle Accidents
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: This process of systems will ensure us safety and protect us by commanding on the speed of the vehicle. In order to protect the vehicle, we use blinking sensors, smoke sensors (MQ2), ultrasonic sensors and other sensors. If any vehicle suddenly hits the road and the vehicle applies the brakes, the system will control the speed and prevent accidents [6]. It likewise alerts the driver, and it demonstrates the driver when they are going to sleep mode during driving. These all sensors take the data from surrounding and send to the microcontroller (ATmega328P) and this microcontroller takes the action automatically. With the help of an IR sensor we will monitor the driver’s eyes [3]. If any short-circuit occurs in parts of the engine, then a smoke sensor will detect it randomly and alert mode will be on for the driver and stop the vehicle. The presence of an Ultrasonic sensor detects the speed of the vehicle and simultaneously decreases the speed to zero.

articleTitle: Identification of a Zebra Based On Its Stripes through Pattern Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Visual animal biometrics are commonly used because they provide a non-invasive and cost-effective means of wildlife tracking. Cameras that are motion triggered capture nearby images of wild animals in their natural environments. This collection of chaotic photos taken in the field was used to create a biometric database of individual animals that can be distinguished from their coat markings. The SIFT Descriptors and FLANN parameters were used in this paper to simplify the dataset by extracting only the patterned parts of the body that can be used for resemblance detection. It was tested using two factors: colour match and feature match.

articleTitle: Smart Gait Detection System With IoT and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Mild stroke symptoms and transient ischemic attack (TIA) normally lasts for sometime and it doesn’t cause any major issues. Sometimes patient is not aware of the symptoms and increases chances of balance loss and fall. These patient need sudden medical help for avoiding permanent disabilities occur due to fall and stroke. The continuous monitoring of movement of the patient can play an important role in detection of different types of gait and prediction chances of fall early. The main aim of the project is to detect gait using sensors and predict chances of fall using machine learning. The movement of patient is detected using three axis accelerometer and force on foot detected by force sensor placed below the foot. The real-time position of patient is pointed on the website with support of global positioning system (GPS) module included in the system. IoT uses in the system for updating sensor data to cloud server (Thingspeak) for conducting study on the data. Machine learning algorithm is applied on the acquired sensor data for predicting the chances of fall. The result shows around 95% accuracy for super vector machine (SVM) algorithm we used for training and prediction.

articleTitle: Software Analysis and Design
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Software analysis and design are relative terms, often used in order to identify software quality attributes and the requirements. It can be considered as a set of yardsticks to measure software quality. The main idea behind writing the technical note on Software analysis and design is to ensure that software professionals develop appropriate quality attributes behaviour and knit software of high quality which comply with fundamental attribute requirements. The software designer, enabled with the insight of software analysis and design requirement, can also assess the software quality for any given application, and produce report for possible improvement areas, design faults etc. It is of utmost importance that the designer should also be well aware about the architecture, notations, programming language and technology stacks which is used to develop the application.

articleTitle: Modelling of wind energy conversion system with MPPT based pitch angle control for DC microgrid application
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The goal of this paper is to use MATLAB Simulink to monitor the maximum power available in the wind energy conversion system modelling for de microgrid applications. MPPT based pitch angle controller in this paper to monitor the maximum power generated by wind energy conversion system. WECS data which is liberated of the wind turbine and system specifications. In this paper used 3-phase diode bridge rectifiers and DC-DC buck converters as power electronics converters. In this paper also simplify the wind energy conversion system by monitoring and varying the pitch angle with the assistance of MPPT controller in order to keep track of the systems full capacity. As a result, WECS able to provide the full amount of power for DC microgrid applications

articleTitle: IoT based Smart Load Management
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: In order to fulfill the consumer load requirement, the generation of electrical energy should be increased & hence installing of generating stations should be increased. To prevent all these unwanted investments load management should be done in a judicial manner which will ensure that produced electrical power is utilized with reduced losses in an efficient way. Electrical load management technologies in general, help to prevent excess demand charges by minimizing peak demand reducing the impact of utility power outages, reducing the utility company’s power factor penalties, reducing the negative effects of low power factor or high harmonic content and automatically monitoring an electrical distribution system. This paper proposes a system with smart techniques for electrical load management which is intended to gain advanced control and minimize costs. IoT is also used to make this demand side management smart by providing an interface for consumers.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Mental Health Using IOT based Wearables
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Mental health assessment and intervention are extending from clinic into daily life. Long -term wellbeing monitoring is principle concern for evaluating health status by collecting physical signs through behavioral attributes. Multisensory information such as temperature sensor, moisture sensor and heart-beat sensors can provide suitable information about mental and physical stress. This paper proposes a novel approach for evaluating mental health using sensors and a camera to capture facial expression, which is to detect a person’s emotion. And also this paper aims in conducting a series of questionnaires with a group of people to objectively look into the relationships between physical and mental health by utilizing the given answers.

articleTitle: Secured And Transparent Voting System Using Biometric And Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The country's "Democracy" permits citizens to elect their representatives, and we must ensure that the power granted to them is properly employed. The traditional way of voting was the ballot paper system, which was later replaced by the electronic Voting System (EVM). The EVM is simple to manipulate since it involves a lot of human participation, which could jeopardize election results by casting bogus votes. It has been observed that there are numerous issues linked with the conduct of elections in the country, including low voter turnout (usually less than 60%), election rigging, and so on.

articleTitle: Performance of Offshore Wind Power Plant for larger distance Power Transmission
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: This paper explores the idea for offshore wind power plant (OWPP) design of electrical system. The paper gives the methodology for calculation of the various parameters to achieve the larger distances. A performance parameter includes optimum frequency, cost, efficiency, reactive losses, voltage, and currents with respect to the distance. For distance like, 50 km, 100 km, 150 km, 200 km up to 500 km respective frequency, cost, and efficiency parameters are calculated to compute the larger distance at the lowest cost and higher efficiency. In accordance with the offshore wind power plant. Hence as working on the power plant also encourages the conservation of eco- system as it is own of the Renewable Natural resources.

articleTitle: Rail Track Defect Detection using Enhanced Method of Magnetic Flux Leakage Signal
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: India procures a major position in the list of quickly developing countries with notable and appreciable advancements in the field of railway network. Derailments contribute to several railway accidents that have been caused. This is mainly due to the cracks in the railway track. These cracks usually go unobserved due to irregular maintenance. Manual track monitoring also adds to this issue of railway accidents. In this work, an autonomous testing train has been proposed for examining and spotting the cracks that are formed in the railway track. It is capable enough to detect even the small cracks caused on the railway tracks. The proposed testing train moves along the allocated path, which is the railway track and detects the cracks and faults in the track. The relevant officials are intimated with the exact location of the crack. In order to examine and determine the cracks in rails using a non-destructive technique, the concept of magnetic flux leakage (MFL) detection is used. It is a widely used non-destructive method that tests rope wire cables on the elevators. Additionally, it is used to examine storage tanks and pipelines if there is any loss of metal due to environmental effects. In this proposed system, two Hall sensors are utilized for the detection of MFL. The exact location of the track with fault is determined and the nearest control room is updated about this through an SMS, hence saving many lives.

articleTitle: Detailed study of 125/60 TPH Aggregate crushing Sand Plant using plethora of machinery
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: This paper elucidates the control mechanism employed for the speed control of three phase induction motors used in a sand manufacturing unit. Moreover, this plant uses three phase induction motors for its various operations and has a production rate of around 125-160 tons of sand per hour. These motors use variable frequency drives (VFD) which are based on programmable logic controllers (PLC). The paper expounds the operation of the plant in-depth, the drawbacks of using aforementioned method of speed control and the need for choosing other speed control strategies so as to improve the speed control of induction motors and thus increases the output of the plant.

articleTitle: Performance Improvement in Sensorless Vector Control of IM using Bus Clamped PWM
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: This paper describes a model-based method for estimating the speed of an induction motor drive that does not have a speed sensor. Because of its less complicated implementation technique, the model-based approach is extensively employed. Vector Controlled Induction with No Sensors To get good dynamic performance, motor control is used. Studies on inverter switching techniques led to the creation of a bus clamped space vector modulation scheme, which has a direct impact on the performance of induction motor drives, particularly in sensorless applications. The modulation technique reduces motor current distortions, pulsation in torque, inverter losses and harmonics in the inverter thus, improvising the performance of the drive. Simulation analysis is performed on MATLAB platform and the results obtained prove the efficacy of Model based speed estimator and Bus Clamped Modulation analogy.

articleTitle: Blackbox System for Car Accident Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: According to the World Health Organization (WHO), more than thousands of people lose their lives from road accidents and nearly twenty percent of these occur in remote areas. The Blackbox project is used to monitor the real time values of the sensors and determine the occurrence of accidents. It also analyzes the cause, time, location of the accident making it possible for the emergency service to reach out for the victim as soon as possible. Alongside monitoring, the values are also being stored in a storage device and also updated on the IoT cloud with the help of Wifi. The exact location of the accident is sent to the emergency contact for immediate assistance. It also includes security measures for the safety of the vehicle. It also includes an on-board emergency control which can be accessed manually by the user.

articleTitle: Wireless Power Transfer to Charge Low Power Device
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The traditional wired charging technique is inconvenient to transport. In order to function or charge, the units must be linked to power outlets. Moving the units takes time, energy, space, and personnel, making it a time-consuming and a costly process. Users' choice and equipment placement may be limited due to system configuration. Electrical surges and failures can cause damage to the wires. The wireless units, on the other hand, can be unplugged at any time if something goes wrong. This paper describes a Wireless Power Transfer system that charges a low-power device utilizing resonant inductive coupling. To properly distribute wireless power, it usually employs a number of transmitters because these transmitters can be employed in large numbers to capture as much energy as feasible also signal and connection losses are reduced. In the current simulated model we are using a 2-coil system because we are supplying the power to a low-power gadget. The circuit was conceived, simulated, prototyped, and tested successfully. It can be used to wirelessly charge a phone, charge a battery, and power medical devices, among other things. The design can work for a wide range of frequency and proves beneficial over certain conventional transmission system. The designed circuit was simulated on Simulink and the results were obtained.

articleTitle: A bridge-free SEPIC for ripple reduction of input current
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: A conventional single ended primary inductor converter, in a word, a SEPIC has a drawback that there are heavy conduction losses at the input bridge diode. This leaves scope for further research on such converters to reduce such losses and thereby increase the efficiency of a SEPIC converter. Design of a bridge-free PFC SEPIC with lower ripples at input current is put forward in this paper. The design presented eliminates input bridge diodes, thereby reducing the losses to a great extent. A supplementary circuit consisting of two supplementary inductors and capacitors is provided in the design to minimize input current ripples. The superiority of the converter put forward as compared to a PFC SEPIC is substantiated with MATLAB simulation.

articleTitle: A Novel Remedy for Image Encryption and Data Hiding
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: With the progression of privacy protection and cloud storage, the concept known as Reversible Data Hiding in Encrypted Images (RDHEI) has earned recognition for secure communication, because it sustains the remarkable property of the initial image being retrieved losslessly after the data embedded in it is obtained while ensuring the image content’s confidentiality. Many encryption algorithms which usually use the concept of chaotic systems have been introduced to preserve digital images against cryptographic attacks. In our paper, we propose an image encryption algorithm which is based on the principle of Rubik’s Cube and RDHEI scheme based on Most Significant Bit (MSB) Steganography. In this method, the image is initially scrambled using the Rubik’s cube principle, and encryption is accomplished using two encryption keys that are randomly generated. Later we analyze the MSB bits of the encrypted image into which the information to be hidden is embedded using a data-hiding key, as per the individual content owner’s requirement. Using MSB Steganography leads to the prevention of hidden data being exposed to cyber-attacks and from being easily cracked. Experimental results prove that the outcome obtained with this method is much better than many of the conventional techniques, taking into consideration both the embedding capacity and reconstructed image quality. We have executed our system on several images, and every time the resulting image has striking similarity to the initial image considering terms such as SSIM and PSNR.

articleTitle: CAMISA: An AI Solution for COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has created an unparalleled need for remote patient monitoring and has primarily impacted the world as the mortality rate has increased rapidly. As long as coronavirus exists, mutations of the virus continue to happen, which also insists on the need for remote monitoring. Healthcare sectors require the help of many new technologies such as IoT, Artificial Intelligence, Neural Networks, and sensor technology which can play an important role. The proposed system predicts the COVID-19 symptoms in a patient with the integration of sensor technology and AI. This system is effective in solving the crisis. It includes a shirt and a mask measuring the heart rate, blood oxygen level, and respiration rate. In addition to this is the predictable AI model, where the symptoms predict whether the patient is COVID-19 positive or not.

articleTitle: Implementation of Convolutional Neural Network for Speed Control of BLDC Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: This paper presents a modern control strategy for the speed control of a Brushless DC (BLDC) motor based on Convolution Neural Network (CNN). The PID loop employed to manage the quickness of the BLDC motor is attenuated using the multi layered perception-based CNN. The modern technique is successful in optimizing the parameters of integral square error of the PID controller. A convolution model is created, compiled and trained based on the verified data and the evaluated model performance. The sequence of speed-controlled data from the controller is to be multiplexed into convolution region, Rectified Linear (ReL) Unit, pooling zone, finally the rest of the error is minimized in fully connected area.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study Of ILST and ANN Algorithm for Control of DSTATCOM
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The subject of the paper is concerned with the simulation and conception of a DSTATCOM using an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) algorithm for controlling an IGBT- based Voltage Source Converter (VSC) for a 3∅-3wire system. The system feeds different loads through the controller, which is accustomed to mitigating power quality complications such as harmonics, unbalance in grid currents, and reactive power. Conventional regulators/control algorithms being fixed design gives ideal execution or result just over a restricted scope of working conditions for which they are planned. Alternative regulators are dependent on neural networks and fuzzy logic, which are sturdier and can be intended to work well under a broad scope of operating conditions. The results of Improved Linear Sinusoidal Tracer (ILST), and Artificial Neural Network (ANN) is presented to show the efficacy of later by simulating the system in MATLAB software using Simscape blockset and their comparison is conferred. The total harmonic distortions of source current and source voltage are estimated which are under IEEE-929 and IEEE-519 guidelines.

articleTitle: Design Solutions for Off-Road Electric Skateboards
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Environmental sustainability and conservation of energy are two of the most pressing challenges of the 21st century century, which has hastened the planning and implementation of electric vehicles. Electric vehicles (EVs) offer a zero-emission transportation network, and thus a new automobile sector and economic growth. Because of its multiple benefits over other electrical machines, in the last few decades, Brushless DC (BLDC) motors have become a common pick in propulsion technology. This paper describes how a BLDC motor is used in the field of electric vehicles, specifically an electric skateboard, and how to control it. The ESC (Electronic Speed Controller) is responsible for this function, and it is normally made up of a power supply stage, a current detection circuit, a microprocessor, and a communication interface. The implementation in this paper involves usage of an open-source ESC called the Vedder ESC or VESC. We will also discuss a proprietary hand-gesture based controller built using the ESP32 microcontroller to propel the board with ease. Also, the paper aims to point out the impact of passive and active cell balancing on battery charging and discharging.

articleTitle: Groundwater anomaly detection using machine learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to present research on modelling and algorithms for groundwater detection. The chosen surrogates are the most correlated features for anomaly detection. The algorithm used in this paper is one class support vector, K- Nearest Neighbors, Gradient Boosting and Decision tree. Colorado River Watch's machine and real-time data are used for putting the model and algorithms through their paces. The Python programme is briefly discussed in order to design the code. Because groundwater contamination is uncommon in practice, we also put our model to the test for anomaly identification using synthetic data from numerical simulations of flow and transport in porous media.

articleTitle: Lifetime Estimation of Electrical Equipment in Distribution system using Modified 3-Parameter Weibull Distribution
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Lifetime and reliability estimation of distribution system components are very crucial for reliable operation of the distribution system. Reliability of the distribution system depends on the reliability of individual components. The distribution system equipment experiences three different types of failures i.e. infant mortality failures, random failures and aging failures. Infant mortality failures will decrease with time, random failures are induced by the external event and its occurrence is constant and random in nature throughout the life of the component. The aging failures increases with time over the useful lifetime of the equipment due to degradation of electrical and mechanical durability. The impact of aging on electrical equipment is modelled by using the failure history of the equipment. The strength of component reduces due to failures, this phenomenon is considered for lifetime estimation of equipment. This paper presents a 3-parameter Weibull distribution function with varying shape parameter for lifetime estimation. The Weibull parameters are determined by using historical failure data and particle swarm optimization. The proposed model is applied to the equipment of the practical Indian distribution system.

articleTitle: Smart Dustbin Using LoRa And Tensorflow Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The traditional trash management system follows a daily timetable that is inefficient and costly. People don't recycle their waste properly, so the current recycle bin has to prove its worth to the general public. With the emergence of the internet of things (IoT) and artificial intelligence (AI) (AI). The old waste management system is replaced with good detectors implanted in the system to perform real-time observation and allow for higher waste management the degree of trash filling. To convey data about, the LoRa communication protocol is employed. The goal of this study is to create a smart waste management system using the LoRa communication protocol and a deep learning model based on TensorFlow. TensorFlow performs real-time object identification and classification, while LoRa provides device information.TensorFlow performs real-time object identification and classification, while LoRa provides device information. The bin is divided into several compartments for garbage separation, including metal, plastic, paper, and general waste divisions, all of which are controlled by servo motors. Using the TensorFlow framework and a pre-trained object identification model, object detection and waste classification are completed. As a consequence of the most method unit, this object detection model is trained with images of rubbish to produce a frozen abstract thinking graph that is utilised for object recognition and completed through a camera connected to the Raspberry Pi 3 Model B+. Each garbage compartment has an unheard detector that monitors the bin's location, real-time status, and filling level.

articleTitle: Simultaneous placement of DG and FACTS device in the Distribution system using Fractional Lévy Flight Bat Algorithm to minimize the Power losses
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: It is a well-known fact that the placement of Distributed Generation (DG) in the distribution system (DS) reduces power losses to a great extent, but DG alone doesn’t fulfill the reactive power requirements of the system. FACTS devices are generally used for reactive power compensation. Hence, simultaneous placement of DG and a FACTS device will not only reduce the power losses, but also compensate reactive power, and improve the voltage profile of the system. This paper introduces Fractional Lévy Flight Bat Algorithm (FLFBA) for the optimal sizing and siting of DG and a FACTS device in the DS to reduce the total active power losses of the system. To check the efficacy of this approach, it has been effectuated on the standard IEEE 33 and 69 bus test systems. The procured results were compared with that of other algorithms like PSO, Bat algorithm, and Firefly algorithm. The comparison of the results shows that FLFBA has a faster convergence rate, and the placement of DG and FACTS device using FLFBA gives better results than the other algorithms.

articleTitle: eSPY Carting Systems:The Real -Time Tracking Mechanism Architecture
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The massive rise in delivery service has necessitated the development of optimized and efficient smart transport operations. To manage engineering applications and anticipate product faults or service failures, a close integration of Internet of Things technology (IoT) and Big Data analytics approaches have become important. Existent process monitoring mechanisms, on the other hand, are not designed for package vendors. The introduction of smart network monitoring is especially useful for shippers in the field of good transportation to ensure trustworthy parcel deliveries.This "eSPY Service" is an advanced system for surveillance and managing deliveries that have been shipped. Back-end infrastructure for intelligent data transfer, governance, processing, and insights is made available and it’s centered on the eSPY Servicing network of IoT-enabled software, which allows courier users to quickly collect parcel identity for each delivery phase. We look at a real-world dataset that includes package delivery case data and a machine-learning algorithm is used to quickly interpret the features representing incident data to forecast possible package splits and to test if the developed system provides information which could be used to determine shipment status (i.e., Tampered or not). The findings further suggested that the systems derived from event-related features own a strong degree of prediction accuracy. This is the first way to mitigate remote monitoring in smart successful supply chains using real-world model to estimate shipment splits with advanced methods employed

articleTitle: Media Platform: Software Testing Prologue
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Media Platform is an evolving industry with footprints in many domains. There are many application types which use Media platforms. Accurate testing ensures superior quality experiences and on time delivery to the end users. With a large suite of best practices that spans the entire software development lifecycle [1] [2] [3] [4], this technical note possesses a library of referenceable test cases that significantly reduce test cases and hence development time.The major challenge of media platforms is delivering quality content over web & mobile application, meeting customer centric content, enabling software systems and network infrastructure.

articleTitle: A Review of Technical Literature and Trends Related to Automotive Engine Modelling by ANN
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The study presents a detailed review on various works in the field of engine modelling and highlights the current trends and requirements in automotive engine modelling. Different modelling techniques and their ability to adapt to the growing needs are studied in the paper. The paper involves three different sections under the review segment tailed by conclusions drawn from the research. The Engine modelling and simulation section focuses on the inclinations in the modelling techniques like lookup tables. ANN performance modelling segment emphases on efficiency of artificial neural networks in engine modelling with help of several literature followed by ANN calibration modelling section drifting the engine calibration techniques. Future scope of the research in engine modelling is discussed at the end of the study stating the fast-growing requirements.

articleTitle: Techniques for Recognizing and Extracting Facial Emotions
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Outward appearance assumes an imperative part in face acknowledgment frameworks and picture handling methods of human machine interface, A human outward appearance is at least one movement or place of the muscles underneath the skin of the face. Facial demeanours are a type of nonverbal communication, they are essential methods for passing on friendly data between humans, but they additionally happen in most different vertebrates and some other creature species. Humans can receive an outward appearance deliberately or automatically and the neural components are liable for controlling the demeanour contrast in each case. Facial feelings assume the most significant part to perceive the goals of others. In this paper detailed study of steps involved in facial emotion recognition and extraction from different medium is discussed. Finally, a system is proposed here to extract facial information from both grey scale & RGB scale images using Robert’s & Sobel’s Techniques. It is trained by a dataset using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model to predict for the test images which can be verified from the result.

articleTitle: Cognitive Machine Learning Model for Soil Property Prediction and Type Classification on Geo-Spatial Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Advancements in the field of machine learning and deep learning have made the research on the soil property and type classification on the spatial data in the recent years with inexpensive and accurate decision making phenomenon. Machine learning techniques are found to the efficient technique that can map high-dimension spectral data to the functional properties of the soil. Most of the existing research works considered nominal regression methods for the prediction, which results in the correlation issue that leverage the actual prediction output. In this research, we proposed deep learning and machine learning methods for the prediction of the functional properties of the soil such as percent organic carbon, total nitrogen, bulk density, pH, vegetation index, water index, percent sand and clay. Methods used for the prediction are divided into two groups, (i) those that use the properties calculated from the Geo-spatial data for the property prediction (ii) those that use the features extracted from the images for the type prediction. Our method is based on the learning algorithms including XGBoost, Support Vector Machine, Faster-Region Based Convolution Neural Network and Random Forest classifier. The implementation is tested on the Geo-spatial data and nominal soil type data and are observed with promising results over property and soil type prediction.. In soil studies with data modelling, there is a need to consider of fluctuation in relations between soil property and its sorts.

articleTitle: Modelling of Automated System based on Hybrid Learning and Ensemble Mechanism for Forecasting Future Solar Energy Generation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Due to changes in weather conditions, solar power generation is prone to fluctuations. Therefore, precise forecasting of future solar power generation is essential for managing an energy network. Various solar energy prediction models based on machine learning methods have been introduced in the existing literature. However, most of the existing literature lacks a proper selection of learning models and feature engineering. A hybrid learning model is developed based on the joint operation of various machine learning techniques empowered by ensemble learning mechanisms in the proposed work. Suitable data preparation and feature engineering are performed, and five important meteorological time-series features were selected to train the proposed hybrid model. The study outcome and performance assessment confirms the potential of the proposed solar energy forecasting model. The proposed hybrid model has been shown to predict solar radiation with an accuracy of 93%, which exhibits the robustness and stability of the proposed hybrid prediction system.

articleTitle: Intelligent Model for Automating PID Controller Tuning for Industrial Water Level Control System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Design Innovations for 3Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: PID Controller has contributed significantly towards industrial control system due to its simplified structure and implementation. After reviewing the existing system, it has been noticed that there is a potential challenge associated with tuning the traditional PID controller, which depends upon the maximum inclusion of the manual process. Considering an industrial water tank system, the proposed system develops a concept of a PID controller to maintain the desired level of water in the tank to achieve higher efficiency. The proposed study constructs a Reinforcement learning Agent to achieve optimal control parameters. The performance of the proposed study is compared with the existing tuning method. Based on the simulated study outcome, it has been analyzed that the proposed study provides intelligent and automatic control for maintaining the desired level of water in the tank. The proposed study is able to continuously maintain the water level in tanks with a smooth transition control process.
